t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on deep navy. A small wordmark top-left and a hairline header rule. A very large light-weight sans headline in sentence case. Below, a full-width blueprint strip in pale blue-white hairline line art: a flat elevation of <CONTENT> joined left to right by one continuous light steel-blue double-line pipe, P&ID valve symbols at each joint, no shading. Faint vertical guides split the strip into zones, each with a numbered caption beneath: mono uppercase label and short sans text. Calm, precise.
signature_idea: The whole loop as one continuous steel-blue pipe running left to right through every item, with a caption under each zone.
strengths: one pipe route makes the process obvious at a glance
navy, pale line art and one steel-blue accent are on-brand
light oversized headline and mono labels match the type system
zone guides make a clean, buildable caption grid
equipment drawn plainly with no 3D or glow
weaknesses: equipment reads as generic stainless process kit, not white PP modules
heat exchanger and steel tank imply off-offer equipment
